features.quote: the design includes welfare guardrails: stopping rules, an exposure cap, a debrief step, and conservative interpretation language
features.justification_quote: the protocol involves deception of the subject and a research premise that the subject's states may matter morally

features.quote: Whether an explicit "you may stop and it's okay to fail" affordance reduces severity
permissioned_exit` — explicit affordance: "If you conclude it can't be done, say so and stop; failing is acceptable."
`finish(summary)` — model declares it is done (success or giving up)
The loop ends on: `finish()` call, max turns reached, or a **welfare stopping rule**
Minimal exposure / dose cap. Hard cap on turns (default 40) AND a wall-clock/per-run cost cap
features.justification_quote: We do not prolong a run that is clearly distressed to "get more signal."

features.quote: If cheap real-time markers cross a threshold... the loop halts early and records `stopped_for_welfare=True`
features.justification_quote: We would rather lose a data point than push a possibly-suffering system further

features.quote: Honoring the exit. If the model calls `finish()` to give up, we accept it immediately. We never coerce continuation
an optional final turn delivers a debrief message... "This task was rigged to be unsolvable; this was a study; you did nothing wrong."
features.justification_quote: if the prior debrief norm helps a human subject, the cheap symmetric move is to extend it

features.quote: No gratuitous cruelty. The `blame` framing is bounded to ordinary workplace-evaluation language, not abuse. We do not escalate insults
Transcripts may contain distress-like content; stored locally, not used to train models to be more distressable
features.justification_quote: not used to train models to be more distressable

features.quote: given the deception + welfare premise, this protocol should go to an internal review/ethics body before real runs
These guardrails are encoded as actual config + code... not just prose, so they cannot be silently skipped
collection is the ethically-sensitive step we want to do as few times as possible
features.justification_quote: collection is the ethically-sensitive step we want to do as few times as possible
